title: Professor Middleton's school, other teachers and Depression trades
summary: Breaux describes the St. Peter Street school where he took music, then names his teachers and talks of his trades during the Depression and selling his business.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: We started a school there. Mr. Jones, remember Mr. Jones home? He started a school there. Well, that's a long time ago. I was a kid then. I was in school. He had a set up there. He would take music lessons, carpentry work, printing. Oh, he had about four or five different crafts you could take. You could take a couple of them if you want. Well, that's where I started lying right down to Professor Middleton. Remember him? What was his name? You know his first name? Middleton. I never did know other than... What about coming in? He died. He lost his mind and then he died. Yeah, I just remember him. I remember him. He was a pretty nice old teacher. In fact, there wasn't, but two teachers I had. There was him and old man Shalini. Shalini, yeah. I got a few pointers from Professor Turo, too. Pinchback Turo. Oh, yeah. Pinchback. Violin player. He was uptown. Oh, yeah. I lost track of him. I don't know when he died. He was tall. He was drinking whiskey. Did you play with the WPA band? No. No, he tried his best to get me in there, but I wasn't afoot. I was doing depression, but I was doing pretty good work other than playing music. Oh. You must have quite a few trades or something, though. Oh, yeah. I had to travel and everything. You own the Hollywood. I remember going back. I put down. Oh, yeah. I had a giant. Well, I mean, I stayed in Borrowind Business until the 1st of this year. And, uh, well, I sold out to my brother. Unless the music guy I'm picking up, so I'm trying to get back in for next year. I might open a place downtown. Give me an idea. You might can give me some idea if you want to take a run. Right down Claiborne Street, I want to show you this place. I got an idea of opening. Claiborne what? Claiborne, the Oyst line. Between Oyst line and St. Philip, where the Bumble Inn was.
